Phase 1 · Team Two

Your structured client role-play

Interview each assigned fictional client, record what is established and unknown, then turn those findings into guardrails for the IPS.

Use the two sources together

Start with the assigned-client slides. They are your baseline case file: age, occupation, income, net worth, stated goal, target return, volatility/risk classification, and the stated constraint. Then use the role-play to learn what those numbers do not settle: which goal comes first, the timing and urgency of cash needs, risk willingness versus capacity for loss, taxes or restrictions, and what remains unknown.

One member receives the sealed role card and becomes the client. The other members ask their own neutral questions. Do not exchange, photograph, or read another student's sealed card.

Activity sequence

One interview at a time

1

Prepare the team role-play

After macro analysis, each team receives three sealed client cards. For the first case, the Client and Macro Strategist begins as the client; the other three members act as analysts. Do not open a card assigned to another student.

2

Interview and rotate

Run a 12-minute interview for each client. Rotate the client role for the second and third cases so different members experience the client perspective. The Portfolio Manager and Risk Analyst keeps the decision-log record consistent across all three cases.

3

Translate and challenge

After each interview, all four members identify established facts, information gaps, and provisional guardrails. Challenge the first interpretation as a committee before moving to the next client.

4

Finish the mandate

Use the three interview summaries, the macro outlook, and the assigned case files to complete the IPS analysis and prepare for Gate 1.

End each interview

Document, challenge, and hand off

  • Separate established facts from assumptions and information gaps.
  • State at least one provisional client guardrail that later security selection or allocation must honor.
  • Record a concise summary in the Analyst Decision Log—not a transcript.
  • Do not recommend a security, fund, ETF, allocation, or trade during discovery.

Return when ready

Convert discovery into the client mandate

Bring the three interview summaries and your macro outlook into the Phase 1 IPS analysis.
